messages.content: 你能產生四個長度為500的不同DNA序列嗎？其中第一個序列偏好核苷酸'A'，第二個序列偏好核苷酸'T'，第三個序列偏好核苷酸'C'，第四個序列偏好核苷酸'G'。

function.name: generate_DNA_sequence
function.description: Generate a random DNA sequence with a specific length and nucleotide preference. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

length.description: The length of the DNA sequence to be generated.

preferences.description: Preferred nucleotides to include more frequently in the DNA sequence.
